[SWS_DM_00356] Requesting Notification of a channel reestablishment
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04168
⌈
The DM shall call the
apext::diag::uds_transport::UdsTransportProto-
colHandler::NotifyReestablishment
method of a UDS Transport Protocol im-
plementation, with the parameter
channelId
set to the identifier of the
Channel
,
where it needs a re-establishment notification.
⌋
